datasets.name: Loess landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: This led to the expansion of the dataset to a remote sensing image dataset consisting of 11,010 images at a resolution of 640 × 640 pixels, which can be found at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10053430 (30 October 2023).

datasets.name: Google Earth optical remote sensing images
datasets.verbatim: The optical remote sensing images utilized in this study were gathered from Google Earth.

methods.name: Improved YOLOv5 landslide detection model
methods.summary: An improved YOLOv5-based object detection model that integrates Coordinate Attention (CA) into the backbone, a C3 module combined with the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) in the neck, a lightweight Decoupled Head Mini, and the SIoU loss function to enhance multi-scale landslide detection.
methods.verbatim: All models are Python-based and publicly available, and the output is available at https://zenodo.org/records/10054497 (30 October 2023).

data_links.name: Relevant replacement files for the YOLOv5 pipeline

code_links.name: YOLOv5 object detection model
code_links.summary: The study's code builds on Ultralytics' YOLOv5 implementation, used as the base object detection model.

availability.author_statement: Full availability statement, with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory dataset is provided via a persistent Zenodo link, and other input imagery is accessible through Google Earth. The custom YOLOv5-based model code is publicly available via a persistent Zenodo repository link.
